description: This file contains unit tests for the reftable merged table functionality, including creating merged tables from records, iterating over references, logs, and testing various behaviors and edge cases.

methods.name: merged_table_from_records
methods.description: Creates a merged table from an array of reference records, initializing tables and sources, and returning the merged table.

methods.name: tables_destroy
methods.description: Decrements reference counts for an array of tables and frees the array.

methods.name: test_reftable_merged__single_record
methods.description: Unit test for merging a single set of reference records and iterating over the merged table.

methods.name: test_reftable_merged__refs
methods.description: Unit test for merging multiple reference records, including deletions and updates, and verifying iteration order.

methods.name: test_reftable_merged__seek_multiple_times
methods.description: Tests seeking and iterating multiple times over the merged reference table.

methods.name: test_reftable_merged__seek_multiple_times_no_drain
methods.description: Tests repeated seeking and iteration without draining the iterator.

methods.name: merged_table_from_log_records
methods.description: Creates a merged table from log records, similar to the record-based version but for logs.

methods.name: test_reftable_merged__logs
methods.description: Unit test for merging log records and iterating over them, including seeking at specific update indices.

methods.name: test_reftable_merged__default_write_opts
methods.description: Tests default write options, creating a table, and attempting to create a merged table with different hash options.
